[M10] FYI: the composer's voice-message button hides where you can't post, with the same check as M11's sticker button: r.posting.can_post(&self.matrix_id, r.encrypted) != Some(false) (rust-client/src/voice_message/recorder.rs, App::mic). If C2 changes that API or adds a per-channel 'send voice messages' permission, tell me on M10 or update App::mic.

From U2 (u2-voice-settings): I'm extending rust-client/src/call_settings.rs (voice.json) with the chosen input/output device, input/output volume, push-to-talk key and camera. The live chosen mic stays App.local_audio.mic (Option<String>, a PulseAudio source name; None = system default) — I keep that field and only load/save it, so reading it for recording keeps working. Input volume will be App.voice.voice.input_volume (percent, 100 = unchanged) if you want to apply it too. Please don't reshape call_settings.rs; tell me here if you need something from it.
